text:
The pedestrian will not prevail on a misrepresentation claim. Fraudulent misrepresentation requires justifiable reliance and resulting damages, and he rejected the $1,000 offer, retained counsel, and recovered a full verdict, so the false statement caused him no loss. An adjuster’s assertion about legal entitlement in an adversarial negotiation is also not a factual representation on which reliance is justified.

CONFIDENCE: 88
